detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Combat

Unlock new weapons, recruit heroes and build your party. Synergize your heroes and shape your own playstyle. Experiment with countless combinations to find the most effective way to loot more!

Upgrades & Progression

Loot coins and items to unlock powerful upgrades in the Skill Tree. Each upgrade strengthens you and your heroes to defeat more skeletons and gather even greater loot. Forge weapons in the Blacksmith, every weapon features its own unique attack animation. Recruit new heroes and upgrade them in Guild, each with different upgrade paths and abilities.

Heroes & Party Building

Recruit, bless and lead a team of heroes through darkest catacomb dungeons. Each hero acts uniquely on the battlefield. Increase your party capacity, combine your heroes to discover powerful synergies, bless them in Guild and create endless combos.

Dungeon Exploration

Explore new dungeon rooms, each with its own drop rates and challenges. Unlock new enemies that drop unique items, use them at the Blacksmith or sell them for coins.

Enjoy the massive variety of content and discover endless ways to grow stronger in Bones and Coins!

Full Game Will Include:

  • 8 dungeon rooms, each filled with unique enemies and loot.

  • 16 weapons, each with its own attack animation.

  • 6 heroes to recruit and build your party.

  • 9 unique enemies, each dropping exclusive items.

  • A vast skill tree with 160+ upgrades.

  • Multiple play styles and countless strategic options.

  • And much more…
